user.title: IQA — Indoor air quality index
user.description: Pick your sensors. Only temperature and humidity are required: the weight of any missing optional sensor is redistributed over the rest.

data_description.room: The threshold profile used for the calculation — not necessarily where the sensor physically sits. An underground garage behaves like a cellar: pick “Basement / Utility room”.
data_description.temperature: Required. If this sensor becomes unavailable, the IQA entity does too, rather than publishing a plausible but wrong score.
data_description.humidity: Required, for the same reason as temperature.
data_description.co2: Optional. Weighted 30 % — the heaviest, alongside PM2.5.
data_description.pm25: Optional. The only particulate fraction counted in the score.
data_description.voc: Optional. The list is not filtered by device class: in index mode, Sensirion sensors declare none.
data_description.voc_unit: Sensirion index 1-500, or concentration in µg/m³.
data_description.nox: Optional. Unfiltered list, same as VOC.
data_description.nox_unit: Sensirion index 1-500, or NO₂ concentration in µg/m³.
data_description.pm1: Optional, display only: nearly redundant with PM2.5.
data_description.pm4: Optional, display only: extrapolated by the sensor, not measured.
data_description.pm10: Optional, display only: extrapolated by the sensor, not measured.
data_description.worst_sensor: A second entity whose state is directly the factor limiting the score, so automations don't have to parse the “detail” attribute.
